_notes: GDINO prompts are engineered to avoid bare tokens like 'body', 'person', 'face' or 'head' — those prompt tokens are the #1 source of false-positive labels on clean skin. Every phrase must contain a visible-injury noun (blood, wound, burn, shrapnel, etc.).

combat_blast.name: Combat / Blast
combat_blast.gdino_prompts: visible blood on clothing . open bleeding wound . deep laceration . penetrating metal fragment . mangled extremity wound . visible burn injury . severe abrasion . road rash injury . exposed bone . tourniquet strap on limb . applied field dressing

civilian_mci.name: Civilian MCI
civilian_mci.description: Mass casualty in civilian context — crush, laceration, impalement.
civilian_mci.gdino_prompts: visible blood on clothing . open bleeding wound . deep laceration . severe abrasion . road rash injury . impaled object . crushed limb . visible burn injury . large bruise . deformed limb

fire_structure.name: Fire / Structure
fire_structure.description: Structure fire — burns, smoke inhalation, airway-first triage.
fire_structure.gdino_prompts: visible burn injury . charred skin . heavy soot deposit . skin blister . singed clothing . full thickness burn . partial thickness burn

mva.name: Motor Vehicle Accident
mva.description: MVA — glass lacerations, crush, seatbelt patterns, deformities.
mva.gdino_prompts: visible blood on clothing . glass laceration wound . deep laceration . severe abrasion . road rash injury . crushed limb . seatbelt contusion . deformed limb . open bleeding wound

cbrn.name: CBRN
cbrn.gdino_prompts: chemical burn injury . skin blister . discolored skin lesion . respiratory distress sign . eye irritation sign . skin necrosis
